definitions.explanation: An extremely polite way to refer to someone's name, used in formal ceremonies, invitations, guest books, and official correspondence. Much more elevated than お{名前|なまえ}.

examples.japanese: ご{芳名|ほうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name (in the guest book).

examples.japanese: ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ご{芳名|ほうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sign your name in the register at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「ご{芳名|ほうめい}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The wedding invitation had 'your name' printed on it (in formal language), so I filled in my name.

notes:
Composed of the honorific prefix ご + {芳名|ほうめい} (fragrant name). The character {芳|ほう} literally means "fragrant" and is used here as an elegant honorific element. This word appears almost exclusively in written formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{芳名|ほうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please write your name
- ご{芳名|ほうめい}⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧: guest book; visitors' register
- ご{芳名|ほうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sign the guest register

USAGE:
Appears on wedding invitations, funeral guest books, formal event reception desks, and official correspondence. When replying to a wedding invitation, etiquette requires crossing out the ご and {芳|ほう} before writing your own name, since these honorific elements should not be applied to oneself.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{名前|なまえ}→お名前：22188_onamae⟧: your name — standard polite form for everyday use
- ⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧: full name — formal but neutral, used on official forms
- ⟦{姓名|せいめい}→姓名：03764_seimei⟧: surname and given name — formal, emphasizes the two-part structure
